title: Cancel Active Closeout Requests After Manual Bag Out Using the OptiSweep API
summary: Use Apidog on a primary server to submit the configured OptiSweep CancelCloseout request after a manual bag out, once the system is running again. Verify the returned response and confirm that the associated active exchange or closeout requests are no longer active.
when_to_use: Use the Apidog / WCS API client on a primary server after a manual bag out has occurred and the OptiSweep system is running again. The manual bag out marks items for exchange; CancelCloseout is used to cancel the resulting active exchange or closeout requests.
not_for: Do not use this procedure to submit undocumented API requests or to invent or modify undocumented request parameters.
Do not use this procedure to establish module-to-module transaction tracing; the source states that this level of tracing is not provided.
Do not use this procedure before the system is running again after the manual bag out.

roles_and_responsibilities.responsibility: Execute the configured CancelCloseout request in Apidog on a primary server and review the returned response.
Review or assist when the request errors, does not return, does not confirm completion, or cancellation is required repeatedly.

safety_notes: This is a recovery action for active exchange or closeout requests associated with a completed manual bag out.
Confirm that the system is running again before submitting CancelCloseout.
Use only the locally installed, shared OptiSweep API project and its configured request parameters.
access_or_tools_needed: L2 or L3 access to a primary server.
Apidog / WCS API client installed on the primary server.
The shared, configured CancelCloseout request and its existing request parameters.

access_required: L2 or L3 access to the primary server hosting the locally installed API project.
Access to Apidog and the shared OptiSweep / WCS API project.
system_preconditions: A manual bag out has been completed.
The OptiSweep system is running again.
Active exchange or closeout requests associated with the manual bag out may still be present.
external_references: Configured API request parameters for CancelCloseout.
API guide for the installed OptiSweep API project, where available on the primary server.

steps.title: Open the shared CancelCloseout API project on a primary server
steps.purpose: Access the locally hosted OptiSweep API request used to cancel active exchanges or closeout requests after a manual bag out.
steps.instruction: On a primary server, open the Apidog / WCS API client and open the shared OptiSweep API project. Locate the CancelCloseout request in the available System API requests.
steps.expected_result: The shared OptiSweep API project is open in Apidog and the CancelCloseout request is visible.
steps.healthy_condition: Apidog displays the locally installed OptiSweep API project and its CancelCloseout request.
steps.failure_condition: The primary server does not have the project, Apidog cannot access the project, or CancelCloseout is not present.

steps.title: Submit CancelCloseout in the OptiSweep API client
steps.purpose: Cancel the active exchange or closeout requests associated with the completed manual bag out.
steps.instruction: In the Apidog / WCS API client, submit the configured CancelCloseout request after confirming that the OptiSweep system is running again.
steps.expected_result: Apidog returns a response to the submitted CancelCloseout request.
steps.healthy_condition: The request completes and Apidog returns a response indicating that the cancellation was accepted or completed.
steps.failure_condition: The request returns an error, produces no response, or does not provide confirmation that cancellation completed.

steps.title: Verify the cancellation response and closeout state
steps.purpose: Confirm that the manual bag-out exchange or closeout requests are no longer active.
steps.instruction: Review the returned response in the Apidog / WCS API client. Confirm that it indicates successful completion, then verify that the active exchange or closeout requests associated with the manual bag out are no longer active using the available live OptiSweep state.
steps.expected_result: The response indicates successful cancellation and the manual bag-out-associated exchange or closeout requests are no longer active.
steps.healthy_condition: Apidog shows a completion response and no associated active exchange or closeout requests remain.
steps.failure_condition: The response does not confirm completion, or the associated exchange or closeout requests remain active.
